name: hardening-flags
description: Blocks added settings that weaken compiler, linker, Rust or kernel hardening, in CMake, Make, meson, configure.ac, Cargo, build.rs, Go release scripts, Dockerfiles and kernel config: no stack protector, FORTIFY_SOURCE off, non-PIE, execstack, norelro, CET off, kernel KASLR/RWX off. Asks on Rust release overflow-checks off, /dev/mem. Not MSVC, sysctl or container settings; misses environment flags, generated files. Runs: commit, agent write, turn's end, CI. Waiver: 'pragma: allowlist hardening-flag'. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
